notes.title: Update notes for June 2022 release
notes.notes:
June 2022 Release:
[list]
[*] Updated render pipeline
[*] Improved player animation, shooting etc
[*] Added inventory/trade screen (press "E"), if you are running out of ammo can buy more with tokens
[*] can also buy more health with food
[*] Player gets a rank and will be promoted throughout the game
[*] Aliens are indeed throwing their poo! Made this more lifelike
[*] Added Look sensitivity override to settings screen
[/list]
New level coming soon! Thanks for playing - Спасибо за игру!
